title: What if you missed the 10 best days?
summary_lines: Hold the S&P 500 from the end of 2005 to the end of 2025 and you'd have 5.48x your money.

facts.post:
Hold the S&P 500 from the end of 2005 to the end of 2025 and you'd have 5.48x your money.
Miss just the 10 best days out of 5,031 and it's 2.44x.

6 of those 10 days came within two weeks of one of the 10 worst. The best days show up when it feels worst.

Ever sold in a panic and watched it bounce right after?
facts.reply: Missing 20 and 30 days, plus the same math for other indexes. Price index, dividends not included.
facts.s2_label: Same 20 years, minus the 10 best days
facts.s3_label: Best days that came within 2 weeks of one of the 10 worst
